title: Spanish practice lesson
description: Format rules for one lesson file. Each lesson is one JSON object with 1 to 15 exercises. Checks that this schema cannot express, and that js/lessons.js also enforces: (1) the file name must be lesson-<lessonId>.json; (2) level must equal the first part of lessonId, and unit must equal the second part; (3) each exerciseId must start with the lessonId and a dot; (4) exerciseId values must be unique within the lesson; (5) audience values must not repeat. The lesson index lessons/index.json lists the lesson files in order. Across files, each lessonId must be unique, and all lessons in one level must use the same stage.

lessonId.description: Level, unit, and lesson numbers joined with dots, for example 1.2.3.

level.description: Whole number. Must equal the first part of lessonId.

unit.description: Whole number. Must equal the second part of lessonId.

title.description: Lesson title in Spanish. Must not be empty.

titleEn.description: Lesson title in English. Shown only when the explanation language is English. Must not be empty.

audience.description: Profiles that can see this lesson. Each profile appears at most once.

exercises.description: Exercises in the order shown. A lesson has 1 to 15 exercises.

exerciseId.description: The lessonId, a dot, and an exercise number of 1 or more.

text.description: The Spanish sentence. The voice says it, and Azure scores against it.

meaningEn.description: English meaning. Keeps the tense of the Spanish sentence.

choices.description: Four image choices. Required for listen_choose only.

image.description: One image that shows the meaning. Not allowed for listen_choose.

voice.description: Azure voice name for Mexican Spanish, for example es-MX-JorgeNeural. The default voice is used when this field is absent.

note.description: Short grammar or usage note, in English (en) and Spanish (es).

pass.description: Pass values for the speech score. Allowed for repeat and read_aloud only.

label.description: English description for the authors. The tool does not show it.

correct.description: True for the one correct choice. Exactly one choice per exercise is true.
